title: A Dream and One Wise Wish
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Young Solomon was crowned the king
When David's reign was through.
He wanted to be good and wise,
And know just what to do.

[Chorus]
Ask God to make you wise and kind,
Not just for toys and things.
Heavenly Father loves that prayer,
And see the good it brings.

[Verse 2]
One night God spoke inside a dream,
"What is it that you need?"
"Not gold," he said, "not long, long life,
But wisdom, Lord, to lead."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and dream, my dear,
And whisper as you pray,
"Please make me kind and brave and wise,"
And God will show the way.

[Chorus]
mood: Dream music. A slow, floating pulse turns under the voice like a little wind-up melody at the edge of sleep, light and starry, matching the night Solomon heard God speak in a dream. The chorus glows a touch brighter, like a wish spoken softly in the dark. By the last verse the turning slows and sinks lower, each line drifting a little further into sleep, until it winds gently down.
